info.author: Kezyma
info.name: Morrowind Remastered - OpenMW Edition
info.summary:
Morrowind Remastered is a purist-friendly modlist that aims to give modern players the opportunity to play Morrowind as it was originally designed, but with quality of life and graphics improvements that enhance the game without changing the original experience from 2002.

- Automated post-install process, no manual editing of configuration or files required.
- OpenMW with enhanced lighting, shadows, and effects.
- Updated textures and meshes, faithful to the original style.
- Purist-friendly implementations of modern features missing from the original game.
- No new quests or landmass, the same game is it was on release.
- Fully voiced dialogue, which can be safely disabled or deleted if not to your taste.

MWSE or OpenMW Edition?
MWSE has more quality of life and UI additions.
OpenMW has better graphics and visual effects.
